user_story: As a user, I want logging out twice in a row to not cause an error so that the logout action is idempotent.

positive.title: User logs out successfully the first time
steps: User is logged into the application.
User is redirected to the login page.
positive.expected_result: User is successfully logged out and redirected to the login page.

positive.title: User logs out successfully the second time
steps: User clicks on the 'Logout' button again.
User remains on the login page.
positive.expected_result: User remains on the login page without any errors.

negative.title: User logs out while not logged in
steps: User is not logged into the application.
negative.expected_result: No action occurs and no error message is displayed.

edge.title: User rapidly logs out twice in a row
steps: User is logged into the application.
User clicks on the 'Logout' button quickly twice in succession.
edge.expected_result: User is logged out successfully and redirected to the login page without any errors.
